title: GhostVue component manifest collection
description: Versioned envelope that bundles unchanged GhostVue component manifests. Each component package publishes one as <package>/manifest.json (scope package); the repository build also writes an unpublished workspace collection (scope workspace). Components are sorted by package, then component name, and each (package, name) identity appears once. Breaking envelope changes bump the $id major version.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this collection envelope's schema, independent of each component manifest's own schemaVersion. Starts at 1.0.0; a major bump also requires a new $id URL.

scope.description: package for a collection published by one npm package (exactly one packages entry); workspace for the unpublished repository-wide build artifact.

packages.description: npm packages whose components this collection contains, sorted by name. Every component's package field names one of these entries.

components.description: Component manifests embedded exactly as checked in, sorted by package and then component name. Each item validates against the component manifest schema.

packages.description: A package-scoped collection describes only the package that publishes it.

package.description: Identity of one npm package contributing components.

version.description: package.json version at build time, so consumers can tell which release the manifests describe.
